work_package: B6-FFAP-SEEDS (wave 2) for steps 0 to 3.2 and B7-FFAP-FEATURES (wave 3) for steps 3.3 and 4; algorithm.rs, this manifest and the support document passed from B6 to B7; port/ffap-semantics (wave 4) for the degenerate bins, FeatureFinderDefs, UnableToFit, the Linux x86_64 Release re-baseline and the intended abundance override evidence
scope: FEATUREFINDER/FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked.h/.cpp end to end: getDefaultParameters, updateMembers_ and the run_ parameter reads, the input checks of run, steps 0 to 3.2 (intensity quantiles and scores, trace scores and local maxima, isotope-pattern precalculation, pattern scores, overall scores and seed selection), positionScore_, nearest_, findIsotope_, isotopeScore_, both intensityScore_ overloads (including the undefined UInt conversion of a zero or infinite bin step, reproduced as the Linux x86_64 Release build computes it, with DegenerateBinStep::Refuse as the opt-out) and getIsotopeDistribution_; steps 3.3 and 4 (findBestIsotopeFit_, extendMassTraces_, extendMassTrace_, chooseTraceFitter_, cropFeature_, checkFeatureQuality_, feature creation, the parallel seed loop with its containment pass, intersection_, the overlap resolution, the apex annotation and the abort counts); and FeatureFinderDefs (IndexPair, IndexSet, ChargedIndexSet, Flag, NoSuccessor). run produces features end to end. Not ported on this branch: writeFeatureDebugInfo_, abort_reasons_ and the ProgressLogger base, which the parallel port/ffap-instrumentation lane ports.
method: Port with executed differential tests. The C2 class-level driver ffap_stages and the B6 driver seed_stage (as its generalisation degenerate_stage) run FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked::run and read its protected state through a derived probe class; since port/ffap-semantics the fixtures come from the Linux x86_64 Release build openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 (ibminode06), extracted by the unchanged B6 and B7 scripts through ../oracle/ffap-sem-completion/extract. tests/feature_finder_picked_seeds.rs rebuilds every configuration with the Rust loaders and compares members, quantiles, isotope windows, all per-peak score arrays and the ordered seed lists bit for bit, plus the degenerate-bin captures (every array with its NaN bits and intensityScore_ as a double), the intensityScore_ probe and the FeatureFinderDefs probe. tests/feature_finder_picked.rs runs the algorithm on each feature-stage configuration, replays step 3.3 seed by seed through the public extension and fitting functions, and compares the intended abundance override with an adapted Release replay (intended_abundance.cpp). tests/topp_feature_finder_centroided.rs compares the tool with the executed Release tool on the degenerate and short inputs and the changed abundance. The executed FeatureFinderCentroided -write_ini output (C1, product SDK) pins the defaults. The disassembly of intensityScore_ in libOpenMS.so explains the degenerate-bin outcome.
evidence_tier: tier 1 (executed differential, Linux x86_64 Release build openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576): effective members, intensity bins and quantiles, isotope windows, every per-peak trace, intensity, local-maximum and pattern score, overall scores (bit for bit except the 8 of 30,840 that glibc 2.39 powf rounds one binary32 step from the correctly rounded power, where the port asserts the correctly rounded value), printed seed counts and min_spectra 1 behaviour over 7 configurations; the degenerate intensity bins over 26 configurations (every array bit for bit with NaN bits, intensityScore_ for every peak, seeds, printed lines, feature counts, abort reasons) and 228 intensityScore_ probe positions; FeatureFinderDefs (defs_probe); the library's final FeatureMap, aborts_ map and two std::cout lines over six configurations, bit for bit on Linux x86_64 glibc except the EGH configuration (2.3038e-12 relative, EGH_LIBM_GAP); the tool on the degenerate, short and changed-abundance inputs. tier 1, product SDK: the default parameters (C1 -write_ini). adapted: the ordered seed lists and the per-seed intermediate state of the C2 replay; the intended abundance override (intended_abundance.cpp). tier 3: all four FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked_test sections, source-order input checks, parameter conversions and refusals; the unreachability argument for UnableToFit. tier 4: hand-derived scoring cases (including the wrapped UInt position and a NaN retention time), area-iterator equivalence, limits, intersection_ cases, the cropping rules, the empty-pattern refusal, the seed-loop ceilings and the thread-count determinism.

oracle.comparison: Exact: every f64 and f32 value of the seed stage bit for bit, every count and index equal, on Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 against the Linux x86_64 Release capture. The single exception is the overall score (source std::pow(float, float), glibc 2.39 powf in the capture): 8 of 30,840 executed values are one binary32 step away from the correctly rounded power; overall_rounding.tsv (and the rounding rows of degenerate_stage.tsv.gz) list them, and the test requires the port's value to be the correctly rounded one there and the executed one everywhere else. The macOS arm64 product SDK's Apple powf misrounded 99. The feature stage is exact on Linux x86_64 glibc except the EGH configuration (2.3038e-12); macOS arm64 is within 5.355e-13 except two ill-conditioned Gaussian fits (1.07e-3) that no feature depends on. The non-finite captures (fix round 1) compare the same way through a digest of every quantile and score, with the full rows where few differ; their features are exact on Linux x86_64 glibc and on macOS arm64 within 5.4e-13 except 11 ill-conditioned fits (up to 1.1156e-12, 6.5974e-8 and 4.9245e-4, NONFINITE_FIT_GAP).

the final intensity divides by the isotope window of the feature's m/z instead of its mass (source review, reproduced)
